from tools import filter_hotels, search_nearest, save_to_cache

# Retrieve the previously filtered hotels
filtered_hotels_result = get_results_from_cache(key="filtered_hotels")

# Filter hotels for the requested amenities: airport shuttle and beach access
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=filtered_hotels_result,
    airport_shuttle_present=True,
    has_beach_access=True
)

# Save the filtered results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels_with_amenities", value=filtered_hotels)

# Search for the nearest attractions based on the filtered hotels
nearest_attractions = search_nearest(
    hotels=filtered_hotels,
    groupBy="hotel"
)

# Save the nearest attractions to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_attractions_from_filtered_hotels", value=nearest_attractions)
